# 12-Week Postpartum Return-to-Fitness Programme

## Client Profile & Clearance Notes
- 33-year-old female, 4 weeks post-uncomplicated C-section
- OB clearance: light activity only until 6-week check
- Equipment: yoga mat only, home-based training
- Key restrictions: no direct abdominal work, no heavy lifting until week 6+
- Assumption: will receive full clearance at 6-week appointment to progress

---

## Programme Overview

This 12-week plan is structured in three phases:

**Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Gentle Reintegration** — Pelvic floor awareness, gentle mobility, walking progression, and foundational breathing patterns while respecting the 6-week surgical healing window.

**Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Progressive Activation** — Post-6-week-clearance progression into light resistance, core reconnection (non-traditional), and cardiovascular base-building.

**Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Strength & Conditioning Foundation** — Structured strength work, integrated core, and return to more demanding movement patterns.

---

## PHASE 1: GENTLE REINTEGRATION (Weeks 1–4)

### Goals
- Restore basic movement patterns and proprioception
- Activate pelvic floor without direct loading
- Build walking tolerance
- Establish breathing and body awareness
- Prepare for 6-week clearance progression

### Key Principles
- All sessions are low-impact and low-intensity
- No direct abdominal bracing or crunching
- Breathing is foundational to every movement
- Listen to scar tissue feedback (mild discomfort is normal; sharp pain is not)
- Sessions are short (20–30 minutes) to avoid fatigue

---

## **Week 1**

### Session Structure
**3 sessions per week** (e.g., Monday, Wednesday, Friday), 20 minutes each

#### **Session Format (all three days)**

**Warm-up (3 minutes)**
- Gentle neck rolls: 5 each direction
- Shoulder circles: 5 forward, 5 back
- Seated cat-cow: 8 reps (on mat, hands and knees)

**Main Work (14 minutes)**

1. **Pelvic Floor Breathing** (3 minutes)
   - Seated on mat, legs extended or knees bent
   - Inhale for 4 counts, relax pelvic floor
   - Exhale for 4 counts, gently engage pelvic floor (imagine stopping urination mid-stream)
   - 10 reps, rest 30 seconds, repeat 2 more sets
   - *Cue: "Breathe into your belly; let your pelvic floor relax on the inhale."*

2. **Glute Bridges (Supported)** (3 minutes)
   - Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat, arms at sides
   - Exhale, press through feet, lift hips to neutral spine (not high)
   - Hold 2 seconds, inhale, lower
   - 2 sets × 8 reps
   - *Cue: "Squeeze your glutes, not your abs. Keep your ribs down."*

3. **Quadruped Rocks** (2 minutes)
   - Hands and knees, wrists under shoulders, knees under hips
   - Rock hips back toward heels, then forward (small range)
   - 2 sets × 10 reps
   - *Cue: "Move from your hips, not your spine."*

4. **Supine Leg Slides** (2 minutes)
   - Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat
   - Slowly slide one heel away, straightening leg (don't lock knee)
   - Slide back, repeat other side
   - 2 sets × 8 each leg
   - *Cue: "Move slowly; stop if you feel pulling at your scar."*

5. **Supported Child's Pose** (2 minutes)
   - Hands and knees, lower hips to heels, forehead to mat
   - Arms extended or by sides (whatever feels comfortable)
   - Breathe deeply, 1 minute hold
   - Repeat 2 times

6. **Supine Pelvic Tilts** (2 minutes)
   - Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat
   - Tilt pelvis to flatten lower back into mat (exhale)
   - Release (inhale)
   - 2 sets × 10 reps
   - *Cue: "Small movement; this teaches your core to work without bracing."*

**Cool-down (3 minutes)**
- Supine figure-4 stretch: 30 seconds each side
- Supine spinal twist: 30 seconds each side
- Deep breathing, lying down: 1 minute

---

## **Week 2**

### Session Structure
**3 sessions per week**, 25 minutes each

#### **Session Format (all three days)**

**Warm-up (3 minutes)**
- Gentle neck rolls: 5 each direction
- Shoulder circles: 5 forward, 5 back
- Seated cat-cow: 10 reps

**Main Work (19 minutes)**

1. **Pelvic Floor Breathing** (3 minutes)
   - Same as Week 1, but add 2 more reps per set
   - 3 sets × 12 reps

2. **Glute Bridges (Supported)** (3 minutes)
   - Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat
   - Lift hips higher than Week 1 (but still controlled)
   - Hold 3 seconds
   - 3 sets × 10 reps

3. **Quadruped Rocks** (2 minutes)
   - Same as Week 1
   - 3 sets × 12 reps

4. **Supine Leg Slides** (2 minutes)
   - Same as Week 1
   - 3 sets × 10 each leg

5. **Bird Dogs (Quadruped)** (3 minutes)
   - Hands and knees
   - Extend right arm forward, left leg back (small range, no hyperextension)
   - Hold 2 seconds, return
   - 2 sets × 8 each side
   - *Cue: "Keep your spine neutral; don't arch your back."*

6. **Supported Child's Pose** (2 minutes)
   - 1 minute hold, repeat 2 times

7. **Supine Pelvic Tilts** (2 minutes)
   - 3 sets × 12 reps

8. **Walking** (2 minutes)
   - Gentle walk around home, 2–3 minutes
   - *Note: Encourage a 10–15 minute walk on non-session days if tolerated*

**Cool-down (3 minutes)**
- Supine figure-4 stretch: 45 seconds each side
- Supine spinal twist: 45 seconds each side
- Deep breathing: 1 minute

---

## **Week 3**

### Session Structure
**3 sessions per week**, 28 minutes each

#### **Session Format (all three days)**

**Warm-up (3 minutes)**
- Gentle neck rolls: 5 each direction
- Shoulder circles: 5 forward, 5 back
- Seated cat-cow: 12 reps

**Main Work (22 minutes)**

1. **Pelvic Floor Breathing** (3 minutes)
   - 3 sets × 15 reps

2. **Glute Bridges (Supported)** (3 minutes)
   - Increase hold to 4 seconds
   - 3 sets × 12 reps

3. **Quadruped Rocks** (2 minutes)
   - Increase range slightly
   - 3 sets × 15 reps

4. **Supine Leg Slides** (2 minutes)
   - 3 sets × 12 each leg

5. **Bird Dogs (Quadruped)** (3 minutes)
   - Increase hold to 3 seconds
   - 3 sets × 10 each side

6. **Glute Activation (Side-Lying)** (3 minutes)
   - Lie on right side, hips stacked, knees bent
   - Lift top knee (clamshell motion), keep feet together
   - 2 sets × 12 each side
   - *Cue: "Feel your glute working, not your hip flexor."*

7. **Supported Child's Pose** (2 minutes)
   - 1 minute hold, repeat 2 times

8. **Supine Pelvic Tilts** (2 minutes)
   - 3 sets × 15 reps

9. **Walking** (3 minutes)
   - Gentle walk, 3–5 minutes
   - *Encourage 15–20 minute walks on non-session days*

**Cool-down (3 minutes)**
- Supine figure-4 stretch: 1 minute each side
- Supine spinal twist: 1 minute each side

---

## **Week 4**

### Session Structure
**3 sessions per week**, 30 minutes each

#### **Session Format (all three days)**

**Warm-up (3 minutes)**
- Gentle neck rolls: 5 each direction
- Shoulder circles: 5 forward, 5 back
- Seated cat-cow: 15 reps

**Main Work (24 minutes)**

1. **Pelvic Floor Breathing** (3 minutes)
   - 3 sets × 15 reps (can increase speed slightly)

2. **Glute Bridges (Supported)** (3 minutes)
   - Hold 5 seconds
   - 3 sets × 15 reps

3. **Quadrupted Rocks** (2 minutes)
   - 3 sets × 15 reps

4. **Supine Leg Slides** (2 minutes)
   - 3 sets × 15 each leg

5. **Bird Dogs (Quadruped)** (3 minutes)
   - Hold 4 seconds
   - 3 sets × 12 each side

6. **Glute Activation (Side-Lying)** (3 minutes)
   - 3 sets × 15 each side

7. **Supported Child's Pose** (2 minutes)
   - 1 minute hold, repeat 2 times

8. **Supine Pelvic Tilts** (2 minutes)
   - 3 sets × 15 reps

9. **Walking** (3 minutes)
   - 5–10 minute walk
   - *Encourage 20–25 minute walks on non-session days*

**Cool-down (3 minutes)**
- Supine figure-4 stretch: 1 minute each side
- Supine spinal twist: 1 minute each side

---

## **6-Week Clearance Checkpoint**

By the end of Week 4, your client will be approaching her 6-week postpartum check-up. **Confirm full clearance from her OB before progressing to Phase 2.** At this point, she should have:

- Restored basic movement patterns
- Improved pelvic floor awareness
- Established a walking routine (20–25 minutes)
- No pain or excessive bleeding with activity
- Confidence in her body's response to gentle loading

---

## PHASE 2: PROGRESSIVE ACTIVATION (Weeks 5–8)

### Goals (Post-6-Week Clearance)
- Introduce light resistance and dynamic movement
- Begin true core reconnection (transverse abdominis, obliques)
- Progress cardiovascular fitness
- Build strength in lower body and posterior chain
- Prepare for Phase 3 compound movements

### Key Principles
- Resistance is minimal (bodyweight, light resistance band if available)
- Core work is functional and integrated, not isolated
- Sessions increase to 35–40 minutes
- Frequency increases to 4 sessions per week
- Walking continues as active recovery

---

## **Week 5**

### Session Structure
**4 sessions per week** (e.g., Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday), 35 minutes each

#### **Session A (Monday & Thursday)**

**Warm-up (4 minutes)**
- Gentle neck rolls: 5 each direction
- Shoulder circles: 5 forward, 5 back
- Seated cat-cow: 15 reps
- Glute bridges: 10 reps (activation)

**Main Work (28 minutes)**

1. **Pelvic Floor Breathing with Movement** (3 minutes)
   - Seated, 3 sets × 15 reps
   - *Add: Exhale and engage pelvic floor while lifting one foot slightly off ground*

2. **Glute Bridges (Progression)** (3 minutes)
   - Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat
   - Lift hips, hold 5 seconds
   - 3 sets × 15 reps
   - *Progression: Pause at top, squeeze glutes hard*

3. **Single-Leg Glute Bridges (Assisted)** (3 minutes)
   - Lie on back, one foot on mat, other leg extended
   - Lift hips using grounded leg (light assist from other leg if needed)
   - 2 sets × 8 each leg
   - *Cue: "This is challenging; 8 reps is enough."*

4. **Bird Dogs (Quadruped)** (3 minutes)
   - Hands and knees
   - Extend opposite arm and leg, hold 4 seconds
   - 3 sets × 12 each side

5. **Quadruped Hip Abduction** (3 minutes)
   - Hands and knees
   - Lift one knee out to the side (hip abduction), keep knee bent
   - 2 sets × 12 each side
   - *Cue: "Feel your outer glute working."*

6. **Supine Dead Bug (Beginner)** (3 minutes)
   - Lie on back, arms extended toward ceiling, knees bent at 90°
   - Lower right arm overhead while extending left leg (small range)
   - Return, repeat opposite side
   - 2 sets × 10 each side
   - *Cue: "Keep your lower back on the mat; move slowly."*

7. **Supported Child's Pose** (2 minutes)
   - 1 minute hold, repeat 2 times

8. **Supine Pelvic Tilts** (2 minutes)
   - 3 sets × 15 reps

**Cool-down (3 minutes)**
- Supine figure-4 stretch: 1 minute each side
- Supine spinal twist: 1 minute each side

---

#### **Session B (Tuesday & Friday)**

**Warm-up (4 minutes)**
- Gentle neck rolls: 5 each direction

- Seated cat-cow: 15 reps
- Glute bridges: 10 reps

9. **Walking** (3 minutes)
